name: agent-turn-changes
title: Agent Turn Changes
description: What a turn changed and drew on, under its answer once the turn has ended. AgentTurnChanges: a 1.5px dotted border-colour rule with 16px above and below separates the answer from the card; callers add no spacing. One file as its diff (with `lines`, folded in its own card past that many), several as a card of them ("3 files changed +18 −3", M/A/D, +n −n), a row opening its file and "View all" all of them, e.g. in the app's panel. AgentTurnSources: the pages the answer drew on as a row of chips, each a link with its icon and site. In an AgentTurnChangesProvider around the turn and its footer, AgentTurnChangesTrigger, the first child of the footer's AgentTurnInfo (one of its facts, "3 files changed +6 −1", one file too, and a small chevron, in their size and grey, hovered in the text's colour; a disclosure, kept with the last fact where the footer is narrow, its words cut first, and shown where the actions show on hover only; 44px under a finger with the footer no taller) opens the card under the answer, no rule, rendered only while open; open/defaultOpen/onOpenChange on the provider.
